messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High GPU queue length detected in us-west2 (spot-pool). queue_depth=372, p95_latency=2.8s, active_preemptions=18, autoscaler_error=ScaleLimitReached. Auto-remediation tried fallback but available dedicated capacity=0. Routing policy tried secondary region but no warm nodes. Paging oncall.
lee (oncall): I'm on it. pulling logs now. first glance: autoscaler failed at 32->48 due to account-scale-limit; spot pool under heavy preemptions.
sara (eng-runtime): Confirmed. autoscaler.log shows repeated RateLimitError from cloud api followed by Azure/GCP 'quota_exceeded' at 06:11:02. Also seeing KV cache pressure: many new sessions causing cold starts.
raj (eng-ml): Which models impacted? are embeddings heavy? any single model dominating tokens?
maria (ops): Customer-facing: multiple retries observed from hosted-api, elevated 502s for some requests. Support reported increased error rate for customers with large-batch streaming. I flagged top 5 customers.
lee (oncall): Quick triage: - stop non-critical batch jobs in us-west2 - enable emergency throttle (50%) for low-tier accounts - attempt to raise scale_limit with cloud provider - start warmup in eu-west1 on-demand. I'll coordinate.
sara (eng-runtime): Commands I'm running now:
```
# cordon batch nodes
kubectl label nodes -l role=batch us-west2 disable-scheduling=true
# set throttling for low-tier routes
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/quotas -d '{"route":"/generate","limit":0.5}'
```
devops-bot: action: scaledown batch-pool-usw2 -> success (30 nodes cordoned). action: queued warmup job to start reserved-on-demand in eu-west1.
raj (eng-ml): Quick model-level note: the 8k-context chat model churns KV aggressively. If we can route high-context sessions to cached model variant (quantized) that might free kernels.
maria (ops): Support update drafted: "We're experiencing degraded performance in us-west2 due to spot GPU interruptions. We're throttling non-critical traffic and routing some workloads to other regions. No customer data exposed. ETA for normal service: 2-4 hours." Want me to send now?
ops-lead: Hold broadcast for 20min until we confirm fallback route is stable. Avoid alarming customers prematurely.
lee (oncall): I'm requesting quota bump with provider support now. submitting ticket: "urgent: scale limit causing production queue growth affecting multiple customers". Ticket# 119834.
sara (eng-runtime): Observed autoscaler errors:
```
E 06:11:02 cloud-api quota_exceeded: request to resize failed
W 06:13:12 scalecontroller: ScaleLimitReached: target=48, applied=32
```
I'll flip the autoscaler to experimental-policy that favors on-demand pools instead of spot when preemptions > 10%.
maria (ops): Support asked which customers are impacted most so they can triage: listed: acct-1243, acct-5552, acct-9912. Notifying customer success on those.
lee (oncall): Switching routing now: enable policy route "prefer-dedicated-when-spot-loss" for priority customers only (p90+). Starting with top-10.
sara (eng-runtime): Implemented routing change: pushed config commit 7c9a3. sample snippet:
```
route_policy:
  - if: request.priority >= 9
    prefer: dedicated
```
devops-bot: warmup eu-west1 reserved pool initiated: target_nodes=16, status=provisioning.
raj (eng-ml): Suggest we also enable short-term quantized variant for chat-heavy flows to reduce kernel memory and allow more concurrent sessions. I can push variant mapping.
maria (ops): Support: initial customer pings coming in. I've set priority flag on acct-1243 and opened incident bridges with them.
lee (oncall): Good. Next: if warmup fails or provisioned nodes <8 in 15m, we'll enable temporary best-effort CPU fallback for embeddings-only endpoints.
sara (eng-runtime): Provisioning update: eu-west1 pool reached 6/16 nodes in 7m, health checks passing on 6. autoscaler still failing to raise us-west2 because provider responded 'preemptibleCapacityExhausted'.
ops-lead: Any risk to config rollbacks? keep changes small and reversible. No schema changes.
lee (oncall): Timeline and short-term impact note:
- 06:08 detection
- 06:10 autoscaler hit limit
- 06:20 throttles + batch cordon
- 06:30 routing changes + warmup
Current status: queue_depth=210 (down from 372), p95_latency=1.6s (down), errors trending down but still elevated.
raj (eng-ml): Pushed model variant mapping for low-memory variant for two heavy routes. will monitor memory pressure.
maria (ops): Support suggests sending a short customer message now: proposing "We're routing high-load traffic to alternate regions and throttling non-critical requests. We're working to restore full capacity; some latency and retries possible." Approve?
ops-lead: Approve with note to avoid SLA language. Send at 06:45 unless metrics back to normal.
devops-bot: Provider response: quota bump request #119834 acknowledged; estimated response ETA 2-3 hours. No immediate quota change.
sara (eng-runtime): 06:40 metrics: queue_depth=95, p95_latency=1.1s, active_preemptions=4. eu-west1 pool at 14/16 nodes healthy and serving ~18% of routed traffic.
lee (oncall): Good progress. Next actions: - keep throttles in place for 30m - keep top-10 customers on dedicated routing - monitor preemption rate; if it spikes >15% re-open page - prepare postmortem template and collect logs (autoscaler, cloud api, node-termination)
maria (ops): I'm scheduling bridge at 07:00 with affected customers for post-incident notes and to capture customer impact window.
ops-lead: After stable for 1h, revert throttles + test autoscaler again in staged mode.
lee (oncall): I'll start post-incident checklist now. tagging folks for follow-up: @sara, @raj, @maria. thanks team. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: ticket created (#119834), warmup started in eu-west1, throttles active. Will append logs to incident record.
